---
pagetitle: "PRIOR checklist"
page-layout: full
toc: false
resources:
  - /assets/logos/equator_logo.png
  - docx.min.js
---

```{=html}
<style>
  #tp-wrap { --accent:#2a5aa7; --head:#bfbfbf; --sect:#b4c6e7; --box:#eef3fb; --boxline:#9fb6dc; --line:#000;
    font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; color:#111; max-width:1000px; margin:0 auto; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-top { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:.8rem; }
  #tp-wrap #tp-logo { width:min(220px,50%); height:auto; display:block; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-right { text-align:right; }
  /* EQUATOR logo: shown on screen, in the saved PDF and in the Word file (hidden automatically if the image file is missing) */
  #tp-wrap .tp-eq { display:block; width:150px; height:auto; margin-left:auto; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:19px; font-weight:bold; line-height:1.3; margin:0 0 .2rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; margin:.4rem 0 .8rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; width:100%; font-weight:bold; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { flex:0 1 50%; min-width:0; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:normal; padding:.35rem .5rem;
    border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); background:var(--box); border-radius:3px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap table { border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; font-size:13px; line-height:1.35; }
  #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap td { border:1px solid var(--line); padding:3px 6px; vertical-align:top; text-align:left; }
  #tp-wrap thead th { background:var(--head); font-weight:bold; vertical-align:middle; }
  #tp-wrap tr.sec td { background:var(--sect); font-weight:bold; padding:2px 6px; }
  #tp-wrap tr.lab td { padding:2px 6px; }
  #tp-wrap td.topic { width:15%; } #tp-wrap td.topic.ind { padding-left:16px; }
  #tp-wrap td.item { width:6%; text-align:center; white-space:nowrap; }
  #tp-wrap td.item .mk { display:block; font-size:11px; color:#333; }
  #tp-wrap th.pgh, #tp-wrap td.pg { width:15%; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg { padding:3px; vertical-align:middle; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); border-radius:3px; background:var(--box);
    text-align:center; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; padding:6px 2px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:hover { border-color:var(--accent); }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:#6a7fa3; font-size:12px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:block; font-weight:normal; font-size:11px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-foot, #tp-wrap .tp-cite, #tp-wrap .tp-lic { font-size:12.5px; margin:.6rem 0 0; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-lic { font-size:11.5px; color:#333; }
  .tp-actions { display:flex; gap:.6rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:1rem 0 1.4rem; }
  .tp-actions button { font:600 15px Arial,sans-serif; padding:.55rem 1.1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer;
    border:2px solid #2a5aa7; background:#2a5aa7; color:#fff; }
  .tp-actions button.alt { background:#fff; color:#2a5aa7; }
  .tp-actions button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f3b800; outline-offset:2px; }
  .tp-note { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; color:#444; margin:0; flex-basis:100%; }

  @media print {
    @page { size:A4 portrait; margin:12mm; }
    body * { visibility:hidden; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap * { visibility:visible; }
    #tp-wrap { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; max-width:none; }
    .tp-actions { display:none !important; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-eq { display:block; }
    #tp-wrap table { font-size:10.5px; }
    #tp-wrap tr { break-inside:avoid; }
    #tp-wrap thead { display:table-header-group; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:15px; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-foot, #tp-wrap .tp-cite { font-size:9.5px; } #tp-wrap .tp-lic { font-size:8.5px; }
    #tp-wrap td.pg input { background:none; border:0; }
    #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:transparent; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:none; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap tr.sec td { -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact; print-color-adjust:exact; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { border:0; padding:0; background:none; flex:1 1 auto; }
  }
</style>

<div id="tp-wrap">
  <div class="tp-top">
    <div></div>
    <div class="tp-right"><img src="/assets/logos/equator_logo.png" alt="EQUATOR Network" class="tp-eq" onerror="this.remove()"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-title">PRIOR checklist of information to include when reporting an overview of reviews of healthcare interventions</div>
  <div class="tp-actions">
    <button type="button" id="tp-pdf">Save as PDF</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-doc" class="alt">Save as Word</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-reset" class="alt">Clear all</button>
    <p class="tp-note">Type the location (page number or section) where each item is reported in the boxes in the right-hand column, then save your copy as a PDF or Word (.docx) file.
    “Save as PDF” opens your browser’s print dialog: choose <em>Save as PDF</em> as the destination.
    Your entries stay in this browser until you clear them.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-meta"><label>Manuscript title: <input type="text" id="tp-title" data-key="title" placeholder="Type your manuscript title here"></label></div>
  <table id="tp-table">
    <thead><tr>
      <th>Section / Topic</th><th class="c">#</th><th>Item</th>
      <th class="pgh">Location reported<span class="tp-hint">type page no. or section in the boxes below</span></th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody></tbody>
  </table>
  <p class="tp-cite">Reference: Gates M, Gates A, Pieper D, et al. Reporting guideline for overviews of reviews of healthcare interventions: development of the PRIOR statement. BMJ. 2022; 378:e070849. <a href="https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj-2022-070849" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj-2022-070849</a>.</p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // Section bars are plain strings; ["L", text] = label row; otherwise [topic, indented?, [[item no, text], ...]]
  const ROWS = [
    "TITLE",
    ["Title", false, [["1", "Identify the report as an overview of reviews."]]],
    "ABSTRACT",
    ["Abstract", false, [["2", "Provide a comprehensive and accurate summary of the purpose, methods, and results of the overview of reviews."]]],
    "INTRODUCTION",
    ["Rationale", false, [["3", "Describe the rationale for conducting the overview of reviews in the context of existing knowledge."]]],
    ["Objectives", false, [["4", "Provide an explicit statement of the objective(s) or question(s) addressed by the overview of reviews."]]],
    "METHODS",
    ["Eligibility criteria", false, [["5a", "Specify the inclusion and exclusion criteria for the overview of reviews. If supplemental primary studies were included, this should be stated, with a rationale."], ["5b", "Specify the definition of ‘systematic review’ as used in the inclusion criteria for the overview of reviews."]]],
    ["Information sources", false, [["6", "Specify all databases, registers, websites, organizations, reference lists, and other sources searched or consulted to identify systematic reviews and supplemental primary studies (if included). Specify the date when each source was last searched or consulted."]]],
    ["Search strategy", false, [["7", "Present the full search strategies for all databases, registers and websites, such that they could be reproduced. Describe any search filters and limits applied."]]],
    ["Selection process", false, [["8a", "Describe the methods used to decide whether a systematic review or supplemental primary study (if included) met the inclusion criteria of the overview of reviews."], ["8b", "Describe how overlap in the populations, interventions, comparators, and/or outcomes of systematic reviews was identified and managed during study selection."]]],
    ["Data collection process", false, [["9a", "Describe the methods used to collect data from reports."], ["9b", "If applicable, describe the methods used to identify and manage primary study overlap at the level of the comparison and outcome during data collection. For each outcome, specify the method used to illustrate and/or quantify the degree of primary study overlap across systematic reviews."], ["9c", "If applicable, specify the methods used to manage discrepant data across systematic reviews during data collection."]]],
    ["Data items", false, [["10", "List and define all variables and outcomes for which data were sought. Describe any assumptions made and/or measures taken to identify and clarify missing or unclear information."]]],
    ["Risk of bias assessment", false, [["11a", "Describe the methods used to assess risk of bias or methodological quality of the included systematic reviews."], ["11b", "Describe the methods used to collect data on (from the systematic reviews) and/or assess the risk of bias of the primary studies included in the systematic reviews. Provide a justification for instances where flawed, incomplete, or missing assessments are identified but not re-assessed."], ["11c", "Describe the methods used to assess the risk of bias of supplemental primary studies (if included)."]]],
    ["Synthesis methods", false, [["12a", "Describe the methods used to summarize or synthesize results and provide a rationale for the choice(s)."], ["12b", "Describe any methods used to explore possible causes of heterogeneity among results."], ["12c", "Describe any sensitivity analyses conducted to assess the robustness of the synthesized results."]]],
    ["Reporting bias assessment", false, [["13", "Describe the methods used to collect data on (from the systematic reviews) and/or assess the risk of bias due to missing results in a summary or synthesis (arising from reporting biases at the levels of the systematic reviews, primary studies, and supplemental primary studies, if included)."]]],
    ["Certainty assessment", false, [["14", "Describe the methods used to collect data on (from the systematic reviews) and/or assess certainty (or confidence) in the body of evidence for an outcome."]]],
    "RESULTS",
    ["Systematic review and supplemental primary study selection", false, [["15a", "Describe the results of the search and selection process, including the number of records screened, assessed for eligibility, and included in the overview of reviews, ideally with a flow diagram."], ["15b", "Provide a list of studies that might appear to meet the inclusion criteria, but were excluded, with the main reason for exclusion."]]],
    ["Characteristics of systematic reviews and supplemental primary studies", false, [["16", "Cite each included systematic review and supplemental primary study (if included) and present its characteristics."]]],
    ["Primary study overlap", false, [["17", "Describe the extent of primary study overlap across the included systematic reviews."]]],
    ["Risk of bias in systematic reviews, primary studies, and supplemental primary studies", false, [["18a", "Present assessments of risk of bias or methodological quality for each included systematic review."], ["18b", "Present assessments (collected from systematic reviews or assessed anew) of the risk of bias of the primary studies included in the systematic reviews."], ["18c", "Present assessments of the risk of bias of supplemental primary studies (if included)."]]],
    ["Summary or synthesis of results", false, [["19a", "For all outcomes, summarize the evidence from the systematic reviews and supplemental primary studies (if included). If meta-analyses were done, present for each the summary estimate and its precision and measures of statistical heterogeneity. If comparing groups, describe the direction of the effect."], ["19b", "If meta-analyses were done, present results of all investigations of possible causes of heterogeneity."], ["19c", "If meta-analyses were done, present results of all sensitivity analyses conducted to assess the robustness of synthesized results."]]],
    ["Reporting biases", false, [["20", "Present assessments (collected from systematic reviews and/or assessed anew) of the risk of bias due to missing primary studies, analyses, or results in a summary or synthesis (arising from reporting biases at the levels of the systematic reviews, primary studies, and supplemental primary studies, if included) for each summary or synthesis assessed."]]],
    ["Certainty of evidence", false, [["21", "Present assessments (collected or assessed anew) of certainty (or confidence) in the body of evidence for each outcome."]]],
    "DISCUSSION",
    ["Discussion", false, [["22a", "Summarize the main findings, including any discrepancies in findings across the included systematic reviews and supplemental primary studies (if included)."], ["22b", "Provide a general interpretation of the results in the context of other evidence."], ["22c", "Discuss any limitations of the evidence from systematic reviews, their primary studies, and supplemental primary studies (if included) included in the overview of reviews. Discuss any limitations of the overview of reviews methods used."], ["22d", "Discuss implications for practice, policy, and future research (both systematic reviews and primary research). Consider the relevance of the findings to the end users of the overview of reviews, e.g., healthcare providers, policymakers, patients, among others."]]],
    "OTHER INFORMATION",
    ["Registration and protocol", false, [["23a", "Provide registration information for the overview of reviews, including register name and registration number, or state that the overview of reviews was not registered."], ["23b", "Indicate where the overview of reviews protocol can be accessed, or state that a protocol was not prepared."], ["23c", "Describe and explain any amendments to information provided at registration or in the protocol. Indicate the stage of the overview of reviews at which amendments were made."]]],
    ["Support", false, [["24", "Describe sources of financial or non-financial support for the overview of reviews, and the role of the funders or sponsors in the overview of reviews."]]],
    ["Competing interests", false, [["25", "Declare any competing interests of the overview of reviews' authors."]]],
    ["Author information", false, [["26a", "Provide contact information for the corresponding author."], ["26b", "Describe the contributions of individual authors and identify the guarantor of the overview of reviews."]]],
    ["Availability of data and other materials", false, [["27", "Report which of the following are available, where they can be found, and under which conditions they may be accessed: template data collection forms; data collected from included systematic reviews and supplemental primary studies; analytic code; any other materials used in the overview of reviews."]]]
  ];
  const TITLE = "PRIOR checklist of information to include when reporting an overview of reviews of healthcare interventions";
  const FOOT = [
    "Reference: Gates M, Gates A, Pieper D, et al. Reporting guideline for overviews of reviews of healthcare interventions: development of the PRIOR statement. BMJ. 2022; 378:e070849. [[https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj-2022-070849|https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj-2022-070849]].",
    "Checklist items reproduced from the PRIOR checklist. Please consult the original publication for the terms of reuse."
  ];

  const STORE = "prior-checklist-v1";
  const tbody = document.querySelector("#tp-table tbody");
  tbody.innerHTML = ROWS.map(r => {
    if (typeof r === "string") return `<tr class="sec"><td colspan="4">${r}</td></tr>`;
    if (r[0] === "L") return `<tr class="lab"><td colspan="4">${r[1]}</td></tr>`;
    const [topic, ind, items] = r, n = items.length;
    return items.map(([code, text, marks], i) =>
      `<tr>` + (i ? "" : `<td class="topic${ind ? " ind" : ""}" rowspan="${n}">${topic}</td>`) +
      `<td class="item">${code}${marks ? `<span class="mk">${marks}</span>` : ""}</td><td class="txt">${text.replace(/\n/g, "<br>")}</td>` +
      `<td class="pg"><input type="text" data-key="p${code}" placeholder="location" aria-label="Location, item ${code}"></td></tr>`).join("");
  }).join("");

  const fields = () => [...document.querySelectorAll("#tp-wrap input")];
  const load = () => { try { const d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || "{}");
    fields().forEach(i => { if (d[i.dataset.key]) i.value = d[i.dataset.key]; }); } catch (e) {} };
  const save = () => { try { const d = {}; fields().forEach(i => { if (i.value) d[i.dataset.key] = i.value; });
    localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(d)); } catch (e) {} };
  load();
  document.getElementById("tp-wrap").addEventListener("input", save);

  // Save as PDF via the browser print dialog (print CSS shows only the checklist)
  document.getElementById("tp-pdf").onclick = () => {
    const old = document.title;
    document.title = "PRIOR checklist";
    window.print();
    document.title = old;
  };

  document.getElementById("tp-reset").onclick = () => {
    if (confirm("Clear all locations and the manuscript title?")) { fields().forEach(i => i.value = ""); save(); }
  };

  // ---- Word (.docx) export -------------------------------------------------
  // <BUILD>
  function buildDocx(D, ROWS, vals, logo, title, foot, eqLogo) {
    const F = "Arial", SZ = 17, W = [1900, 600, 6566, 1400], TOTAL = W.reduce((a, b) => a + b);
    const ln = { style: D.BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 6, color: "000000" };
    const run = (text, o = {}) => new D.TextRun({ text, font: F, size: o.size || SZ, bold: o.bold, superScript: o.sup });
    const runs = (text, o = {}) => {
      const out = [], re = /\[\[(.*?)\|(.*?)\]\]/g; let last = 0, m;
      while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
        if (m.index > last) out.push(run(text.slice(last, m.index), o));
        out.push(new D.ExternalHyperlink({ link: m[2], children: [new D.TextRun({ text: m[1], font: F, size: o.size || SZ, color: "0563C1", underline: {} })] }));
        last = re.lastIndex;
      }
      if (last < text.length) out.push(run(text.slice(last), o));
      return out;
    };
    const lines = (text, o) => text.split("\n").flatMap((l, i) => i ? [new D.TextRun({ break: 1 }), ...runs(l, o)] : runs(l, o));
    const cell = (i, text, o = {}) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: o.span ? TOTAL : W[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnSpan: o.span ? 4 : undefined, rowSpan: o.rowSpan,
      verticalAlign: o.mid ? D.VerticalAlign.CENTER : D.VerticalAlign.TOP,
      shading: o.fill ? { type: D.ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: o.fill, color: "auto" } : undefined,
      margins: { top: 40, bottom: 40, left: o.indent || 90, right: 90 }, borders: { top: ln, bottom: ln, left: ln, right: ln },
      children: [new D.Paragraph({ keepNext: o.keepNext, alignment: o.center ? D.AlignmentType.CENTER : D.AlignmentType.LEFT, children: lines(text, o) })]
    });
    const hd = { fill: "BFBFBF", bold: true, mid: true };
    const head = new D.TableRow({ tableHeader: true, cantSplit: true, children: [
      cell(0, "Section / Topic", hd), cell(1, "#", { ...hd, center: true }),
      cell(2, "Item", hd), cell(3, "Location reported", hd)] });
    const body = ROWS.flatMap(r => {
      if (typeof r === "string") return [new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [cell(0, r, { span: true, fill: "B4C6E7", bold: true, keepNext: true })] })];
      if (r[0] === "L") return [new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [cell(0, r[1], { span: true, keepNext: true })] })];
      const [topic, ind, items] = r;
      return items.map(([code, text, marks], i) => new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [
        ...(i ? [] : [cell(0, topic, { rowSpan: items.length, indent: ind ? 260 : 90 })]),
        cell(1, marks ? code + "\n" + marks : code, { center: true }), cell(2, text), cell(3, vals["p" + code] || "", { center: true, mid: true })] }));
    });
    const para = (children, o = {}) => new D.Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 80 }, ...o, children });
    const footer = new D.Footer({ children: [new D.Paragraph({ alignment: D.AlignmentType.CENTER,
      children: [new D.TextRun({ children: ["Page ", D.PageNumber.CURRENT, " of ", D.PageNumber.TOTAL_PAGES], font: F, size: 18 })] })] });
    const top = [];
    const none = { style: D.BorderStyle.NONE, size: 0, color: "FFFFFF" };
    const noBorders = { top: none, bottom: none, left: none, right: none };
    const HW = [6200, 4266];
    const hcell = (i, children) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: HW[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, borders: noBorders,
      verticalAlign: D.VerticalAlign.CENTER, margins: { top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0 }, children });
    const left = logo ? [para([new D.ImageRun({ data: logo, type: "png", transformation: { width: 180, height: 64 } })], { spacing: { after: 0 } })] : [para([], { spacing: { after: 0 } })];
    const right = eqLogo
      ? [para([new D.ImageRun({ data: eqLogo, type: "png", transformation: { width: 140, height: Math.round(140 * 90 / 310) } })], { alignment: D.AlignmentType.RIGHT, spacing: { after: 0 } })]
      : [para([], { spacing: { after: 0 } })];
    top.push(new D.Table({ width: { size: HW[0] + HW[1], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: HW, borders: { ...noBorders, insideHorizontal: none, insideVertical: none },
      rows: [new D.TableRow({ children: [hcell(0, left), hcell(1, right)] })] }));
    top.push(para([], { spacing: { after: 60 } }));
    top.push(para([run(title, { bold: true, size: 24 })], { spacing: { after: 100 } }));
    top.push(para([run("Manuscript title: ", { bold: true, size: 20 }), run(vals.title || "", { size: 20 })], { spacing: { after: 120 } }));
    return new D.Document({
      title: "PRIOR checklist", creator: "PRIOR checklist",
      sections: [{
        footers: { default: footer },
        properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 }, margin: { top: 720, bottom: 800, left: 720, right: 720 } } },
        children: [...top, new D.Table({ width: { size: TOTAL, type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: W, rows: [head, ...body] }),
          ...foot.map((t, i) => para(lines(t, { size: i === 1 ? 14 : 16 }), { spacing: { before: i ? 60 : 140 } }))]
      }]
    });
  }
  // </BUILD>

  const loadDocx = () => window.docx ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const el = document.createElement("script");
    el.src = new URL("docx.min.js", document.baseURI).href;
    el.onload = res; el.onerror = () => rej(new Error("Could not load docx.min.js"));
    document.head.appendChild(el);
  });

  document.getElementById("tp-doc").onclick = async () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById("tp-doc"), label = btn.textContent;
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Preparing…";
    try {
      await loadDocx();
      const logo = null;
      let eqLogo = null;
      try { eqLogo = new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(new URL("/assets/logos/equator_logo.png", document.baseURI))).arrayBuffer()); } catch (e) {}
      const vals = {}; fields().forEach(i => vals[i.dataset.key] = i.value);
      const blob = await window.docx.Packer.toBlob(buildDocx(window.docx, ROWS, vals, logo, TITLE, FOOT, eqLogo));
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([blob], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" }));
      a.download = "PRIOR-checklist.docx";
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Sorry, the Word file could not be created. " + e.message);
    } finally { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = label; }
  };
})();
</script>
```
